title: Cake Pops
attribution: Recipe adapted from Food Fusion (foodfusion.com). Not an official Food Fusion product.

items.raw: Prepared butter cream frosting 3-4 tbs or as required

steps.instruction: In bowl,add butter and beat until fluffy.
steps.romanUrdu: Bowl mein makhan dal dein aur fluffy hunay tak beat ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add vanilla essence,icing sugar and beat until well combined & refrigerate until use.
steps.romanUrdu: Vanilla essence aur icing sugar dal ker ache tarhan beat ker lein & istamal hunay tak refrigerate ker lein.

steps.instruction: Crumble the cake pieces into fine crumbs with your hands in a bowl.
steps.romanUrdu: Bowl mein cake pieces dal ker haath ki madad sa ache tarhan crumble ker lein.

steps.instruction: Mix in about 3-4 tbs of prepared butter cream frosting and mix until well combined.
steps.romanUrdu: 3-4 tbs tayyar butter cream frosting dal ker ache tarhan mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: Take a mixture and smush the mixture in your hand to pack tightly into a ball and roll it into nicely shaped balls (makes 10-12).
steps.romanUrdu: Mixture ko haath mein la ker ache tarhan pack ker lein aur balls tayyar ker lein (makes 10-12).

steps.instruction: In double boiler,add water and bring it to boil.
steps.romanUrdu: Double boiler mein pani dal dein aur ubal anay dein.

steps.instruction: Place bowl,add cooking chocolate and mix well until smooth and remove from heat.
steps.romanUrdu: Bowl rakh dein aur cooking chocolate dal ker smooth hunay tak melt ker lein aur chulhay sa hata lein.

steps.instruction: Now dip your cake pop stick into melted cooking chocolate and quickly stick it into a cake pop and refrigerate for 30 minutes.
steps.romanUrdu: Ab cake pop sticks ko melted cooking chocolate mein dip karein aur foran cake pops mein laga lein aur 30 minutes kliya refrigerate ker lein.

steps.instruction: Dip your cake pop sticks into melted cooking chocolate and coat evenly.
steps.romanUrdu: Cake pop sticks ko melted cooking chocolate mein dip ker ka evenly coat ker lein.
Multi sprinkles sar garnish ker lein aur thanda ker ka serve karein.

steps.instruction: Garnish with multi sprinkle and chill until set & serve!

ogDescription: Here is a weekend treat for your kids (Cake pops). Give it a try and enjoy your time in the kitchen with the little ones. #HappyParentingToYou
